questions.prompt: Malcolm arrived between 10:20 AM and 10:35 AM for two consecutive weeks.
questions.feedbackText: This is a verifiable, observable fact backed by attendance records.

questions.prompt: Malcolm clearly does not care about his job.
questions.feedbackText: This is an assumption about intent — not an observable, documented fact.

questions.prompt: Malcolm's repeated lateness delayed team meetings.
questions.feedbackText: This describes an observable operational impact that can be evidenced.
Character judgements are opinions. HR documentation must stick to observable behaviour.
